svg.title: Read, write, and critical write paths of wago-plc-mcp-server
svg.desc: Three lanes. Read: Claude, MCP server, WDA, PLC. Write: live mode through the MCP server write gates, or GitOps mode through a pull request, dry run, review, and the CI runner. Critical write: refused in live mode, approved pull request in GitOps mode, and firmware only with the fwupdate tool and a policy committed to Git.
